description: Start (wake) the hosted Dev-Agent runner on Cloudflare for a person of the ACTIVE tenant — nothing to install; it sleeps by itself after ~10 minutes without activity and only awake minutes are billed. Takes about 30 seconds until it shows as 'Bereit' on the Dev-Agent page. Optional size: 'lite' (no browser, about a quarter of the cost) or 'browser' (real Chromium). Remembers the hosted runner as this person's choice. If no Claude/Anthropic access is stored for the runner, the reply says so: then sign in once in the slot settings (Execution runner → Log in).

size.description: Takes effect on this start if the runner is asleep.

user_id.description: Whose runner (one container per person). Default: you — or, if you have no Dev-Agent access in this tenant, the one person here who has. Another person's runner needs the admin role in this tenant.

name: start_cloud_runner
